items.headline: Sesko 'getting there' with recovery from injury
items.summary: Benjamin Sesko continues rehabilitation at Carrington after missing pre-season friendlies. The forward is progressing but not yet at full training intensity.

items.headline: United beat Rosenborg 5-0 in pre-season friendly
items.summary: Michael Carrick claimed first win as permanent manager. Academy players and Joshua Zirkzee impressed in routine victory in Norway.

items.headline: Martinez future uncertain after Copa America injury
items.summary: Lisandro Martinez to be medically evaluated on return to pre-season. World Cup winner's future depends on recovery assessment.

items.headline: Pre-season update: transfers, injuries and Rashford situation
items.summary: United lost out on transfer targets including Anderson to Man City (£116m). Sesko back training on grass. Santos impressing in fitness work.
